asideTitle: Your text never leaves this page

faq.a: No. This tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Your text is never uploaded, stored, or sent anywhere.
faq.q: Is my text sent to a server?

faq.a: Yes. The first occurrence of each line is kept in its original position; later repeats are removed.
faq.q: Does it keep the order of my list?

faq.a: By default, lines must match exactly. Turn on case-insensitive matching to treat lines that differ only in letter case as duplicates.

heroSubtitle: Paste a list or any text and remove repeated lines instantly — keeping the first copy of each line, in order.
metaDescription: Remove duplicate lines from any text instantly. Paste a list, drop repeated lines, keep the original order — free, private, runs in your browser.
title: Remove Duplicate Lines — Free Online Tool | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: It compares whole lines only — it cannot find near-duplicates that differ by a typo, extra space, or punctuation.
For code or data where leading spaces are meaningful (indentation, CSV), check the result before replacing the original.
